title: Field complex homotopy normal form
statement: theorem homotopyEquiv_of_single_field_homology {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (hR : IsField R) (P : CochainComplex (Spec R).Modules ℤ) (i r : ℕ) (hzero : ∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ i → IsZero (P.homology q)) (hnegative : ∀ q : ℤ, q < 0 → IsZero (P.homology q)) (hrank : (P.homology i).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r) : Nonempty (HomotopyEquiv P ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor (Spec R).Modules (i : ℤ)).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := (Spec R).ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))))

proof.text: Combine the assumed vanishing in negative degrees with the natural-degree vanishing. For an integer q>=0, write q as the cast of its natural representative; this yields vanishing in every integer degree other than i.
Apply new-field-complex-single-cohomology to obtain a homotopy equivalence from P to the single complex on H^i(P). This step involves no choice of a basis and does not require finite rank.

Use the rank-r locally free trivializing open cover of H^i(P). Choose the open containing the unique point of Spec R. This open is top, so restriction is along an isomorphism and isoFreeOfRestrictIso gives H^i(P) isomorphic to the rank-r free sheaf. Map this isomorphism through the single functor, regard it as a homotopy equivalence, and compose with the contraction.

proof_origin.place: Field-complex splitting in lem-pc-finite-free-single-field-fibre proof step 2; N2 separates contraction and basis identification.
